subject: Taxes
title: Progressive vs. Flat Tax
description: A micro-lesson that makes Progressive vs. Flat Tax usable.

hook.text: Should everyone pay the same tax rate, or should the rich pay a higher percentage?

buildup.text: Progressive tax charges higher rates on higher income: 10% on the first $10K, 22% on the next $30K, and so on.

discovery.text: Flat tax charges one rate for everyone: 15% whether you earn $30K or $3M. Supporters call it simple and fair.

twist.text: Estonia adopted a flat tax in 1994 and boomed economically. But critics say flat taxes shift the burden onto the poor.

climax.text: No country has settled this debate permanently. The choice between progressive and flat reflects deep values.

punchline.text: Same rate for all, or more from the rich? The debate never ends.

quiz.question: Which country adopted a flat tax in 1994?
